steam_page.short_description: Rocky Idle es un juego idle/incremental para un solo jugador. Mejora tus habilidades, recolecta recursos y completa tu registro de colección.
steam_page.long_description: Rocky Idle is the first game I’ve developed, and it's been under development for 2,5 years, hope you enjoy it!. It's a single-player idle/incremental game. You level up 18 different skills simply by clicking a tree or a rock. You collect items that can be used to advance your character or level up other skills. You also have an active boost that can be activated once every 10 minutes; the boost becomes stronger and stronger as you progress. Skilling There are skills like Mining, Woodcutting, Crafting, and more. Each skill serves its own purpose, use the rocks mined to smith stronger gear, and increase your max hit. The more you use a resource, the stronger and more efficient it becomes, improving speed, batch size, and active boosts. Background Farming & Passive Activities. Farming, and questing all run passively in the background once started. Plant and harvest crops to craft potions. The more you harvest, the more efficient your crops become, growing faster and yielding higher rewards over time. Contracts.   Contracts are rare drops from skilling and combat. Complete specific tasks to receive keys.Offline progress. Keep progressing even while you’re offline. When you return, get a detailed summary of all the resources gathered and experience gained. Automated Combat & Collection. Use your crafted gear, food and potions in automated battles. The more you fight, the stronger your gear and boosts become. Defeat monsters to fill your collection log and unlock upgrades. Good luck getting little Rocky's Apron drop, it's quite rare. Purchase on Steam (Windows) and link your Google account to continue your progress on the WEB version! Note: A Wi-Fi connection is required to play this game. This ensures your data is saved to the cloud and allows you to share progress across different devices.

help.intro: Don't know how to play the game? Here are some tips to get you started.

get_started.title: Get Started
get_started.navigation_text: Click the icons in the navigation bar on the left to open the respective skill.
get_started.inventory_text: Once you click a resource (like a rock), you'll automatically receive items in your inventory. You can drag and drop items around the 24 slots, and you can interact with them by clicking on them. (Clicking a food will eat it; clicking a potion will drink it, etc.)
get_started.bank_text: If your inventory becomes full, open the bank (press B or use the bank icon on the left) and deposit items by clicking them in the inventory. If you don't see the bank icon, you might have a restricted account — check Settings and change your account type if you want to use the bank.
get_started.goal_text: Level up skills & train different skills to unlock new content, complete quests, and earn achievements.
get_started.item_wiki_text: See the Item Wiki to out find what an item is used for and how to obtain it.
get_started.item_wiki_callout: Curious about an item, find it in the

early_tips.title: Tips for early game
early_tips.starting_off_text: Begin with easy quests and train gathering skills such as Mining, Woodcutting, and Fishing. Complete achievements as a long-term goal to unlock permanent boosts.
early_tips.quests_while_skilling_text: Start quests while skilling or fighting to progress multiple goals simultaneously.
early_tips.combat_text: Check a monster's weaknesses and choose the corresponding attack style for better accuracy. Smith gear, make potions, and cook food before engaging in combat.

skilling.title: Skilling
skilling.skills_12_text: Each skill has a set of resources that can be trained individually.
skilling.gathering_text: The gathering skills are Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Farming, Arcanery and Thieving. Most of these skills do not require items to train. They are usually slower to train than production skills but will give you the chance of collecting Contracts and 'Skilling Boss Tokens'.
skilling.production_text: The production skills are Smithing, Fletching, Cooking, Alchemy, Prayer, and Crafting. These skills require items collected from gathering skills or from killing monsters.
skilling.boosts_text: Each resource requires a certain number of actions to reach higher tiers. Each time you tier up, the resource progresses faster.
skilling.tools_text: Each skill has a set of tools that can be bought for coins; these speed up resource actions for that skill.
skilling.pet_text: After unlocking skilling bosses you have a chance to obtain a skilling pet. Pets are cosmetic and a rare collectable.

combat.title: Combat
combat.intro: Combat includes the following skills: Melee, Ranged, Magic, Defence, Hitpoints, and Prayer. Melee, Ranged, and Magic are the three attack styles. Melee uses standard weapons, Ranged requires a bow and arrows, and Magic requires a staff and sigils. Train Defence by selecting the Defence XP option on a monster page regardless of your chosen attack style.
combat.defence_text: Leveling Defence increases your block chance against monsters. Stronger armor improves block chance. Metal gear resists Ranged attacks, mage gear resists Melee, and ranged gear resists Magic.
combat.offense_text: Stronger gear increases accuracy and max hit, hover an item in the inventory to view its stats or look it up in the item-wiki. Leveling Ranged, Magic, or Melee also increases accuracy and max hit for that style.
combat.combat_text: Check what a monster is weak to and choose the corresponding attack style for better accuracy. Smith gear, make potions, and cook food before entering battle.
combat.magic_text: Equip a staff to select spells. Different spells require specific sigils (Earth, Fire, Ice, etc.) that can be found or crafted.
combat.ranged_text: Equip a bow and arrows to use ranged attacks. Hover a bow in the inventory to see compatible arrows.
combat.potions_text: Drink potions to temporarily boost your levels, increasing max hit and accuracy and enabling stronger spells. Auto-drink potions can be bought with Slayer points.
combat.food_text: Eat food to restore Hitpoints during battle. Keep a good stock to avoid dying. Auto-eat can be bought with Slayer point.
combat.prayer_text: Train Prayer by using bones on an altar in the Prayer skill page. Bones are gathered from monsters or bought in the shop. Leveling Prayer unlocks combat prayers that grant various boosts.
combat.hitpoints_text: You gain Hitpoints experience each time you deal damage to a monster, regardless of combat style. The rate is 0.33 XP per damage dealt. Leveling Hitpoints increases your maximum health, helping you survive longer in combat.
combat.hits_text: Each attack can be a miss (0) or a successful hit depending on accuracy. On success, damage is randomly chosen from 1 to your max hit. Accuracy and max hit depend on levels, gear, potions, and active prayers.
combat.offline_text: Monsters will continue to be fought until you die or stop the fight; offline progress will simulate combat up to 24 hours.

monsters.title: Monsters
monsters.monster_info_text: Click the Monster Info Icon in the top left of a monster's image to view detailed statistics. Use these stats to choosing the right gear and attack style.
monsters.defensive_bonuses_text: Low values represent weaknesses. For example, a -400 Melee Defence means the monster is extremely vulnerable to Melee attacks, significantly increasing your accuracy when using that style.
monsters.accuracy_bonuses_text: This shows how proficient the monster is with its own attacks. Higher accuracy bonuses for a specific style mean you'll need higher Defence or better matching gear to block those hits.
monsters.combat_styles_text: Displays the monster's available attack types and their Max Hits. Hover over a style to see the percentage chance of the monster choosing that specific attack during the fight. The style is rolled randomly every attack.
monsters.slayer_categories_text: Monsters belong to specific Slayer categories. While on a Slayer task, you gain XP equal to (Monster Hitpoints / 2) per kill. Note: Slayer XP is not affected by extra rolls.
monsters.rolls_text: When a extra roll triggers, you receive extra items, but your Slayer XP remains base value. However, the rolls will decrease your remaining Slayer task count by the rolled amount.

gear.title: Gear
gear.intro: There are three gear sets. They let you store best-in-slot items for each combat style.
gear.melee_text: Melee combat. Equip swords or scimitars. You can train Melee and Defence; click the XP icon on a monster page to switch to Defence XP.
gear.ranged_text: Requires a bow and arrows in your ammo slot. Different bows use specific arrow types. You can train Ranged or Defence.
gear.magic_text: Equip a staff to select spells; you must also have the required sigils in your inventory. You can train Magic or Defence.

boosts.title: Boosts
boosts.skilling_combat_text: Two boost types: Skilling and Combat. Skilling boosts increase batch size and speed. Combat boosts increase max hit, accuracy, and attack speed. Activate boosts using the yellow or red lightning icons. Base duration is 20 seconds and can be increased by completing achievements.
boosts.active_effect_text: Activating a boost grants the temporary effect.
boosts.cooldown_text: Boosts have a cooldown of 10 minutes after they expire.
boosts.achievements_text: Completing Medium (adds 2s) and Expert (adds 5s) achievements increases boost durations permanently for each area completed.
boosts.boosts_progress_text: For example: mining a rock raises its tier over time; each new tier grants skilling points. Hitting certain milestones increases boost power. The same applies to combat—more kills raise tiers. The highest tier is Diamond. See the Boosts page for details and hover the progress bars under the images to view progress toward the next tier.

containers.title: Containers & Storage
containers.intro: Containers can be acquired by completing Hard achievements; they provide additional storage slots for the inventory. Items that can be stored in these containers are limited to specific item types. If a container is in your inventory, items you gain will automatically go into the container and will be used from the container as needed.
containers.list_intro: Below is a list of available containers and the items they can store:

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.challenges_text: Once opened, you'll receive a set of challenges, e.g., kill Moozey 10 times or fish 12 raw catfish.
contracts.chests_text: When you complete the challenges you receive a key to open the associated chests.
contracts.combat_text: Small chance to get one from killing monsters.
contracts.skilling_text: Small chance of getting one when gathering resources, like woodcutting.
contracts.contract_cases_text: Obtained from crafting sigils in the Arcanery or as monster drops.
contracts.quests_text: Early quests reward you with contracts.

quests.title: Quests
quests.what_are_text: A quest is a long-term task that can be started when requirements (such as skill levels or items) are met. Once started, quests run in the background and you can collect the reward when they finish (they continue while you're logged out). Quests can be started while doing other activities like skilling.
quests.why_text: Quests are a great way to gain experience in different skills. They also unlock new monsters, resources, and items (see the shop in the Quest tab).
quests.points_text: You gain Quest Points by completing quests. They aren't spent directly, but higher Quest Point totals unlock additional quests and slayer block slots.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.what_are_text: Each of the 7 areas in the game has its own set of achievements, consisting of 5 tiers of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, and Nerd.
achievements.how_to_text: Complete all the challenges — they progressively get harder with higher difficulties. Achievements always require you to have a certain set of quests completed, have killed a certain number of monsters, and completed specific skilling and level requirements.
achievements.tip_text: Achievements grant permanent boosts and other rewards. Complete them whenever you can.

collection_log.title: Collection Log
collection_log.three_sections_text: The Collection Log has three sections: 1) Skilling tools (bought in skill pages), 2) Pets (rare drops from combat and skilling bosses), and 3) Monster drops (regular monster loot).
collection_log.why_text: It's primarily a completionist feature—collect items and show off your progress. It doesn't directly affect core progression.

shop.title: Shop
shop.buy_text: Buy items you need and sell items you don't (sell for {{percentage}}% of the buy price). Some items are locked behind quests or achievements.
shop.no_items_label: Why are there no items in my shop?
shop.no_items_text: This may be because your account is in Wilderness or Countryside mode. Those account types require you to find items yourself. To unlock the full shop, change your account type in Settings.

openables.title: Openables
openables.intro: Openables are items that can be opened to receive random rewards. Each openable has a number of drop rolls that determine how many chances you have to receive items from it. To open an openable, click it in your inventory. To open multiple at once, right-click (or long-press) the item and select the "Open All" option.
openables.hover_hint: Hover items below to see how likely each item is to be dropped.

account_types.title: Account Types
account_types.intro: When you create a character, you can choose between different game modes. Once you pick a game mode it can only be downgraded. Wilderness mode is the hardest; you can downgrade to Countryside, then to City mode. It is not possible to upgrade the account after creation.
account_types.countryside_text: Shops are limited; you'll need to obtain items by killing monsters and crafting them.
account_types.wilderness_text: Shops are extremely limited, and you only have your inventory for storage (no bank).
account_types.city_text: All shops are unlocked and many items are available from vendors rather than drops.

offline_progress.title: Offline Progress
offline_progress.intro: While you're logged out, your character will simulate progress and grant rewards when you log back in. Offline progress represents what you would have gained while playing and is capped at 24 hours (unless you die or run out of resources). Progress can be in Skilling or Combat — no action is needed other than closing the tab for skilling. For combat you need to unlock the ability to kill them offline.
offline_progress.skilling_text: Works for up to 24 hours or until you run out of usable resources.
offline_progress.combat_text: Works for up to 24 hours or until you die. Offline combat requires you to unlock the ability inside the slayer page under the offline tab.
offline_progress.quests_text: Timers continue while you're away; harvest crops and collect quest rewards when you log back in.

items.title: Items
items.lock_text: Right-click an item inside your inventory and lock it. Locked items will not be deposited into the bank when you click 'Deposit All Items', and you also cannot sell or destroy a locked item.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: To navigate the game faster, you can use the following keyboard shortcuts:
shortcuts.convenience_text: You can click most monsters, resources, and other elements to quickly navigate to their pages. If you hover an element and see an orange border and background, clicking it will take you directly to that page.
shortcuts.other_text: Monsters, skills, resources, quests, and achievements can be pinned to the shortcuts bar. Hovering an item shows a bookmark icon; click it to add the item to your shortcuts. Press keys 1–9 to jump to the corresponding shortcut.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.tokens_a: Skilling tokens can be used to challenge skilling bosses once unlocked at level 75. Boss tokens can be used to challenge a specific boss. These bosses are usually difficult.
faq.save_a: Saves locally once every 10s and on certain events + auto saves to cloud once every 2h.
faq.dead_q: I am dead, how can I become alive?
faq.dead_a: Eat cooked food by clicking it (Lobster, Silver Minnow etc.) in your inventory to restore Hitpoints.
faq.leaderboard_q: Can we have a leaderboard please?
faq.leaderboard_a: No, sorry but it is not possible since it is too easy for cheaters to ruin the entire leaderboard. The game once had a leaderboard, and I spend way too many hours finding and removing cheaters.
faq.drops_q: I have 20k kills and have not gotten the 1/5k drop, is the game bugged?
faq.drops_a: Most likely you're just unlucky; in rare cases it could be a bug.

description.equipable: Click the item while it's inside your inventory to equip the item.
description.potion: Click the potion while it's inside your inventory to gain a skill level boosts for a short duration, when unlocked you can drink potions automatically while in combat.
description.food: Click the food while it's inside your inventory to heal some health, when unlocked you can eat food automatically.
description.xp_lamp: Click the lamp while it's inside your inventory to collect your well deserved experience.
description.openable: Click the openable item while it's inside your inventory to gain some nice rewards.
description.contract: Click the contract while in your inventory to start the challenges.
description.extra_container: Items that provide additional storage space for the player to carry more items, when gaining any of the allowed items while having the container in the inventory will cause the items to go directly into the container.
description.pet: Pets are purely for style points.
description.prayer_unlocks: Items that unlock new prayers when the item is clicked while being inside the inventory. Note: A prayer can only be unlocked once.
description.token: Special items used to kill 1 boss per token. There are 6 Skilling tokens and 6 Boss Tokens in the game.

boosts.skilling_description: Every time you tier up a resource it will become faster but you will also get skilling points. Here is an overview of all tiers reached and how many skilling points you earn for each tier.
boosts.combat_description: Every time you tier up a monster it will increase the drop rolls but you will also get combat points. Here is an overview of all tiers reached and how many combat points you earn for each tier.
boosts.skilling_milestone_description: Once a skilling points milestone is hit, the active skilling boost will become stronger
boosts.combat_milestone_description: Once a combat points milestone is hit, either the active combat boost will become stronger, or a set of gear slots will get a stats multiplier boost.
boosts.maxed_out: - You are sick, you are maxed out
